jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Spirii is looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer.

If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer in our Payments team within the Engineering department, you will help enhance the backbone of the Spirii platform that turns charging data into accurate invoices, credit memos, and payouts. It's a domain where correctness and financial data integrity are non-negotiable. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

What You Will Do

Together with your team, you will be responsible for:

Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.
Ensuring data quality through correct aggregation and safe handling of late or updated records.
Building and maintaining integrations with internal services and our ERP system.
Significantly contributing to architectural decisions and solution design for cloud-native, distributed, event-driven systems on AWS.
Driving automated testing and observability to protect billing correctness and catch data discrepancies early.
Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar of the team through code review, pairing, and constructive feedback.
Operating independently on ambiguous, cross-team problems with minimal oversight.
Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate development and automate repetitive tasks while helping the team adopt AI safely in a financially sensitive codebase.

Who You Are

Like to explore innovative technologies, including AI tools and agentic workflows, and continuously expand your skills.
Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.
A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.
Skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous initiatives into vertical slices that deliver value incrementally; you default to shipping in small, regular batches rather than big-bang releases.
Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.
Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of professional software development experience.
Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.
Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.
Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.
Hands-on experience with test-driven development, test automation, integration and load testing.
Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.
Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.
Experience with developing secure software is a plus.
Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.
Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.
Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its seven-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

jobs.title: Digital Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

We are hiring a Solution Engineer (“SE”) to help support our fastest growing AI-centric startups and software development company customers to build, optimize, and scale on Microsoft Azure. This role focuses on helping earn customer trust in technical decisions by connecting our customers’ products and business outcomes to practical cloud, AI, data, and application architectures, then proving those architectures through demos, workshops, pilots, and production-readiness plans.

This requires work across account teams, specialists, partners, customer success teams, and engineering and product groups to unblock adoption, accelerate opportunities and turn customer ambition into measurable Azure usage, revenue, and long-term platform commitment. This role requires both technical depth and commercial judgement. The SE must influence and support senior technical leaders in our customer accounts to remove blockers, qualify technical risk, create repeatable patterns, and help progress opportunities across regions.

Responsibilities

Own the technical strategy for assigned customers across the customer adoption journey from discovery through technical to close, MVP, pilot, and production adoption and scaling phases.
Lead architecture-led customer conversations across Azure AI, application innovation, data platforms, developer tools, cloud operations, governance, and security topics.
Design credible end-to-end solutions using services and technology including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI agents, Azure Kubernetes Service, containers, serverless, APIs, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power BI, and GitHub.
Deliver demos, whiteboarding sessions, architecture workshops, proof of concepts, and technical validations that demonstrate clear business value and a sensible path to production for customers.
Translate customer product goals, business priorities, and technical complexity into decision criteria, success plans, implementation roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
Identify and remove technical blockers including architecture gaps, security concerns, capacity and quota constraints, migration risks, integration challenges, and operational readiness issues.
Partner with account executives, specialists, and customer success teams to support pipeline creation, opportunity progression, technical win documentation, milestone hygiene, and forecast quality.
Differentiate Microsoft against competitors by positioning Azure as a trusted, secure, scalable, and integrated platform for AI-native software companies.
Capture reusable patterns, lessons learned, field feedback, and customer insights so we can scale our business consistently across the globe.

Customer scenarios this role will support

AI-native application development: agents, copilots, RAG, evaluation, model selection, observability, responsible AI, inference optimization, and production AI operations.
Cloud-native platform scaling: high-growth infrastructure, reliability, performance, capacity, quota, networking, observability, and global scale.
Data-driven modernization: database migration, analytics modernization, AI-ready data foundations, governance, cataloging and data integration.
SMB and software company growth: SaaS architecture, multi-tenant platforms, marketplace readiness, co-sell motions, developer productivity, and product-led growth.
Technical acceleration: workshops, hackathons, migration programs, partner-led scale motions, and repeatable delivery playbooks.

Qualifications

Experience in technical pre-sales, solution engineering, cloud architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.
Demonstrated ability to influence technical and business stakeholders, including CTOs, founders, engineering leaders, architects, and product leaders.
Hands-on understanding of cloud architecture and modern application design, including security, reliability, scalability, integration, and operations.
Practical experience with AI, data, analytics, application modernization or developer platform solutions on Azure or comparable cloud platforms.
Experience creating demos, prototypes, POCs, pilots or MVPs that lead to technical decisions and production adoption.
Strong communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills; ability to drive consensus without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Depth in one or more of: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, agentic systems, RAG, Azure Kubernetes Service, containers, serverless, API platforms, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power BI or GitHub.
Experience working with startups, SMBs, SaaS, marketplace, venture-backed or product-led-growth customer scenarios.
Understanding of AI governance, Responsible AI, security, compliance, model evaluation, observability, cost management, and FinOps.
Ability to support technical sales motions across complex territories, multiple stakeholders, and fast-moving customer priorities.
Experience with competitive positioning and objection handling in AI, cloud platform, data, or developer tool markets.
Spoken and written Mandarin fluency is a nice-to-have but not strictly required.

What good looks like

Customer obsessed: earns trust with senior technical leaders by combining curiosity, clarity, and practical technical depth.
Hands-on and credible: can whiteboard, demo, prototype, and pressure-test an architecture rather than simply presenting slides.
Commercially aware: connects technical decisions to pipeline, consumption, revenue, growth, risk reduction, and customer outcomes.
Operationally disciplined: maintains clear milestones, blockers, next steps, technical win evidence, and repeatable account motions.
Globally collaborative: works effectively across time zones, regions, partners, and internal specialist teams.
Comfortable with ambiguity: thrives in fast-moving environments where customer priorities, architectures, and business models evolve quickly.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Engineer - Mid-Level & Senior
jobs.description:
Overview

Every minute of every day, customers stake their entire business and reputation on Microsoft Cloud. The Engineering Operations (EngOps) team believes that when we meet our high standards for quality and reliability, our customers win. If we falter, our customers fail their end-customers. Our vision is to turn Microsoft Cloud customers into fans.

We are hiring both mid-level and senior Customer Experience Engineers to join our Engineering Operations (EngOps) team.

We are customer obsessed problem-solvers. We orchestrate deep engagements in areas like incident management, support and enablement. We analyze and amplify those customer voices, both within our own team, and across the Cloud + AI team, bringing the customer connection to the Quality vision for Azure. We innovate ways to scale what we learn across our customer base. Diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, how we work, and what we enable our customers to achieve. We know that empowering our customers starts with empowering our team to show up authentically, work in ways that are effective for them, and achieve their career goals.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing teams within Microsoft Azure Engineering? Are you constantly customer-obsessed, and focused on enhancing customer experience? Are you passionate about cloud computing and love the challenge of solving the most complex technical problems?

Come join us and surround yourself with people who are passionate about cloud computing and believe that extraordinary support is critical to customer success.

As a customer focused Senior Advanced Cloud Engineer, you are the primary support and engineering contact accountable for the customer’s Azure support experience driving resolution of complex critical problems and supporting key customer projects on Azure. You will also act as the voice of the customer within Azure to escalate problems and to drive prioritization of platform/support improvement needs for customers.

In this role, you will work together with field teams (Customer Success Account Managers, Cloud Solution Architects, Support Escalation Engineers) and Azure engineering teams with our mission to turn Azure customers into fans with a world-class engineering-led support experience.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Development & Automation Skills

Experience developing production-grade solutions using one or more programming languages such as C#, Python, Java, JavaScript, or Go. Ability to build automation, tooling, APIs, and telemetry-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

Solution Engineering & Cloud Architecture

Experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting cloud-native solutions with knowledge of distributed systems, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and end-to-end customer solution lifecycle management. Ability to engage in development scenarios, and partner directly with engineering teams to drive product and service improvements.

Technical Oriented

Utilizes engineering tools, customer telemetry and direct input. Flags the patterns of defects/signals in the products or issues across customers. Inform customers and partners about the complex thematic active issues, progress made on them and discuss next steps.

Synthesize feedback from customers and partners to learn about the product usage and identify and resolve feature and knowledge gaps and key performance indicators (KPIs) in the current product. Leads team in sharing insights and best practices with customers and partners on these service improvements.

Recommend changes to content improvement or troubleshooting guides and develops metrics to evaluate the changes.

Customer Solution Lifecycle Management

Utilizes cross systems to conduct health checks to ensure the customer environment (e.g., product, service, feature) is optimized and configured for deployment. Provides guidance to customers on understanding and implementing new versions. Serves as a connecting point between the engineering team and customers throughout the solution’s lifecycle. Utilizes any resources to respond and resolve the immediate issues throughout the solution lifecycle. Proactively provides guidance to customers on designing configurations and deploying solutions on Microsoft platforms.

Handles complex escalations on customer issues from the support or field teams. Conducts impact analysis to determine the priority of the escalations.

Conducts deep root cause analysis of the issues and converts them into improvement opportunities. Serves as an escalation resource in areas of subject matter expertise. Represents the team on highly complex issues and answers a large variety of technical questions and concerns.

Relationship/Experience Management

Acts as a voice of customers and leverages customers' feedback to provide input on business plans developed by the relevant product and business groups. Identifies customer usage patterns and driving resolutions on reoccurring customer issues with engineering and product and business groups. Leads their team in engaging with feature and product groups on redesign/customer requested changes for Microsoft products. Close the loop of feedback with the customers on product features.

Partners with other teams (e.g., program managers, software engineers, product, customer service support [CSS] teams) prioritize and drive resolutions of complex, high-impact customer issues and integration of customer features into the products. Leads discussions with stakeholders on customer progression and provide expertise on resolutions plans for common types of customer issues. Proactively communicates the translation of signals into actionable insights/trends to product teams to improve service reliability. Leads coordination with stakeholders (e.g., engineering/product teams) to develop mechanisms that improve customer health engagement and reduce the turnover time.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND extensive experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND extensive experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience.

Extensive demonstrated IT experience supporting and troubleshooting enterprise level, mission-critical applications resolving complex issues/situations and driving technical resolution across cross-functional organizations.

Extensive experience in an external customer / client facing role.

Proven experience working on cloud computing technologies.

Experience with being on-call.

Technical Skills: Cloud computing technologies. Demonstrated hands on experience in one or more of the following:

Core IaaS: Compute, Storage, Networking, High Availability, Azure Kubernetes Service

Data Platform and Bigdata: SQL Server, Azure SQL DB, HDInsight/Hadoop, Machine Learning, Azure Stream Analytics, Azure Data Factory / Data Bricks, Cosmos DBAzure PaaS Services: Redis Cache, Service Bus, Event Hub, Cloud Service, IoT suite, Mobile Apps, etc.

Communication skills: ability to empathize with customers and convey confidence. Able to explain highly technical issues to varied audiences. Able to prioritize and advocate customer’s needs to the proper channels. Take ownership and work towards a resolution.

Customer Obsession: Passion for customers and focus on delivering the right customer experience.

Growth Mindset: Openness and ability to learn new skills and technologies in a fast-paced environment.

These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Develop end-to-end, high-performance, scalable, and sustainable product features across frontend and backend
Analyze requirements and design, develop, test, and deploy solutions to production.
Build modern applications using .NET Core and React + TypeScript, working with REST APIs, microservices, and distributed architectures
Design and maintain sustainable software architectures based on System Design, Software Architecture, DDD, SOLID, Design Patterns, and Clean Code principles, while contributing to reducing technical debt
Identify and resolve production performance issues and database bottlenecks through optimization techniques
Implement secure software solutions using JWT, OAuth2, and Identity/RBAC, and contribute to CI/CD, Docker, and testing processes
Work with SignalR, Hangfire, frontend state management, and API integrations to deliver reliable and scalable applications
Collaborate with Product and Analytics teams to turn business requirements and mockups into working products and technical solutions
Take end-to-end ownership of problems from analysis through production and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Leverage AI development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor to produce secure, high-quality code

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
At least 5 years of professional full-stack development experience, including hands-on experience taking at least one product from scratch to production
Strong production-level experience with .NET Core and React + TypeScript
Strong knowledge of System Design, Software Architecture, DDD, SOLID, Design Patterns, and Clean Code principles
Experience with REST APIs, gRPC, microservices/distributed architectures, database optimization, and modern frontend development
Strong understanding of security, CI/CD, Docker, OWASP, Unit/Integration Testing, and secure software development practices
Experience with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic APM, Kubernetes, or Helm is a plus
Proficiency in English sufficient to read and write technical documentation and work with global partners
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a high sense of ownership, and the ability to communicate technical topics clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience with NoSQL technologies such as Redis, MongoDB and Elasticsearch
Proficiency in RDBMS technologies such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB
Knowledge of Python is a plus
